title: BIL User Manual
lede: How to use the Blazing Imaging Library: what to call, what comes back, what it costs, and what runs today.
control: Mostly specified; the core pass prototyped; the NITF and GeoTIFF readers and JPEG 2000 codec built
footer: BIL User Manual, version 11, written beside the code against version 73 of the Blazing Imaging Library (BIL) specification, as of 15 October 2026. Calls shown as Specified do not run yet.
